import{expect,test,beforeAll,beforeEach,afterEach,afterAll}from'vitest'
const emit=row=>console.log('EXPECT_STATE_ROW '+JSON.stringify(row))
const nativeBind=Function.prototype.bind
function initial(phase){let binds=0,callbacks=0,threw=false,error=null;const callback=()=>{callbacks++;return 1};Object.defineProperty(callback,'bind',{get(){binds++;if(this!==callback)throw new Error('wrong bind receiver');return nativeBind}});try{expect.poll(callback,{interval:1,timeout:1000})}catch(reason){threw=true;error={name:reason?.name??null,message:reason?.message??String(reason)}}emit({kind:'hook-admission',phase,binds,callbacks,threw,error})}
beforeAll(()=>initial('beforeAll'))
beforeEach(()=>initial('beforeEach'))
test('actual Test owns polling',async()=>{let callbacks=0;const initial=expect.poll(()=>{callbacks++;return 1},{interval:1,timeout:1000});await initial.toBe(1);emit({kind:'body-admission',callbacks})})
afterEach(()=>initial('afterEach'))
afterAll(()=>initial('afterAll'))
